title: Tabbar margins are inconsistent and do not fill to content
line: Plasma styles whose active-tab highlight is a full frame can now have the highlight around an open panel widget surround its icon or text instead of being drawn over it.
explanation: The 'expanded' indicator of panel applets (CompactApplet.qml) and Show Desktop's active indicator use the style's widgets/tabbar active-tab frame. Along the panel they only reach into the applet's panel margins, which suits Breeze's thin line, but styles whose active tab is a full frame (like the reporter's Sumac Night Molten Glass) draw their side borders over the Kickoff icon and the clock text, and Show Desktop's frame was also stacked on top of its icon. Styles can now add a `<prefix>-hint-around-applet` element to their tabbar.svg; the frame then grows along the panel by its own margins (at least the panel margins it already covered), so its borders surround the applet. Show Desktop's frame is drawn behind its icon; Breeze and styles without the hint look exactly as before.

commits.message:
applets: let styles draw the expanded frame around the applet

Along the panel the expanded indicator only grew into the panel margins,
so styles whose active tab is a full frame drew its borders over icons
and text. These styles can now add a hint to grow it by its own margins.

BUG: 511837

patches.diff:
From a894ad221e79ed5e090ce04334e117be6ffd2431 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: =?UTF-8?q?Niccol=C3=B2=20Venerandi?= <niccolo@venerandi.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 09:39:52 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] applets: let styles draw the expanded frame around the applet

Along the panel the expanded indicator only grew into the panel margins,
so styles whose active tab is a full frame drew its borders over icons
and text. These styles can now add a hint to grow it by its own margins.

BUG: 511837
---
 applets/showdesktop/main.qml                     | 15 +++++++++++----
 desktoppackage/contents/applet/CompactApplet.qml | 13 +++++++++----
 2 files changed, 20 insertions(+), 8 deletions(-)

diff --git a/applets/showdesktop/main.qml b/applets/showdesktop/main.qml
index 7f284c707d..67d3cea3d4 100644
--- a/applets/showdesktop/main.qml
+++ b/applets/showdesktop/main.qml
@@ -115,7 +115,9 @@ PlasmoidItem {
 
         // Active/not active indicator
         KSvg.FrameSvgItem {
+            id: activeIndicator
             Accessible.name: i18nc("@label Accessible name", "Minimize All Applet Active Indicator")
+            z: -1
             property var containerMargins: {
                 let item = this;
                 while (item.parent) {
@@ -127,15 +129,20 @@ PlasmoidItem {
                 return undefined;
             }
 
+            // Styles whose active tab is a full frame can ask for it to grow along the
+            // panel by its own margins, so its borders surround the icon.
+            property bool aroundApplet: false
+            onRepaintNeeded: aroundApplet = hasElement(`${usedPrefix}-hint-around-applet`)
+
             anchors {
                 fill: parent
                 property bool returnAllMargins: true
                 // The above makes sure margin is returned even for side margins
                 // that would be otherwise turned off.
-                topMargin: containerMargins ? -containerMargins('top', returnAllMargins) : 0
-                leftMargin: containerMargins ? -containerMargins('left', returnAllMargins) : 0
-                rightMargin: containerMargins ? -containerMargins('right', returnAllMargins) : 0
-                bottomMargin: containerMargins ? -containerMargins('bottom', returnAllMargins) : 0
+                topMargin: containerMargins ? -Math.max(containerMargins('top', returnAllMargins), root.vertical && activeIndicator.aroundApplet ? activeIndicator.margins.top : 0) : 0
+                leftMargin: containerMargins ? -Math.max(containerMargins('left', returnAllMargins), !root.vertical && activeIndicator.aroundApplet ? activeIndicator.margins.left : 0) : 0
+                rightMargin: containerMargins ? -Math.max(containerMargins('right', returnAllMargins), !root.vertical && activeIndicator.aroundApplet ? activeIndicator.margins.right : 0) : 0
+                bottomMargin: containerMargins ? -Math.max(containerMargins('bottom', returnAllMargins), root.vertical && activeIndicator.aroundApplet ? activeIndicator.margins.bottom : 0) : 0
             }
             imagePath: "widgets/tabbar"
             visible: opacity > 0
diff --git a/desktoppackage/contents/applet/CompactApplet.qml b/desktoppackage/contents/applet/CompactApplet.qml
index 384a406c77..f2a07f0d41 100644
--- a/desktoppackage/contents/applet/CompactApplet.qml
+++ b/desktoppackage/contents/applet/CompactApplet.qml
@@ -119,15 +119,20 @@ PlasmaCore.ToolTipArea {
             return undefined;
         }
 
+        // Styles whose active tab is a full frame can ask for it to grow along the
+        // panel by its own margins, so its borders surround the applet.
+        property bool aroundApplet: false
+        onRepaintNeeded: aroundApplet = hasElement(`${usedPrefix}-hint-around-applet`)
+
         anchors {
             fill: parent
             property bool returnAllMargins: true
             // The above makes sure margin is returned even for side margins, that
             // would be otherwise turned off.
-            bottomMargin: containerMargins ? -containerMargins('bottom', returnAllMargins) : 0
-            topMargin: containerMargins ? -containerMargins('top', returnAllMargins) : 0
-            leftMargin: containerMargins ? -containerMargins('left', returnAllMargins) : 0
-            rightMargin: containerMargins ? -containerMargins('right', returnAllMargins) : 0
+            bottomMargin: containerMargins ? -Math.max(containerMargins('bottom', returnAllMargins), vertical && expandedItem.aroundApplet ? expandedItem.margins.bottom : 0) : 0
+            topMargin: containerMargins ? -Math.max(containerMargins('top', returnAllMargins), vertical && expandedItem.aroundApplet ? expandedItem.margins.top : 0) : 0
+            leftMargin: containerMargins ? -Math.max(containerMargins('left', returnAllMargins), !vertical && expandedItem.aroundApplet ? expandedItem.margins.left : 0) : 0
+            rightMargin: containerMargins ? -Math.max(containerMargins('right', returnAllMargins), !vertical && expandedItem.aroundApplet ? expandedItem.margins.right : 0) : 0
         }
         imagePath: "widgets/tabbar"
         visible: opacity > 0
--

reviews.text: This patch should not be merged as-is because introducing an ad-hoc opt-in '<prefix>-hint-around-applet' SVG hint in two plasma-desktop QML files does not fix existing 9-piece third-party Plasma styles (including the reporter's) out of the box and invents a new undocumented theme API outside libplasma/VDG review while omitting System Tray's tabbar highlight in plasma-workspace. Worse, expanding the FrameSvgItem via negative anchor margins beyond containerMargins causes the highlight frame to bleed outside the applet bounds into adjacent panel items and edges—visible in after-3.png (clock top border overlapping the System Tray arrow while side borders still clip the vertical clock text) and after-1.png (Kickoff frame clipping the panel's left edge and Show Desktop's frame overlapping the clock's 'M'). The z: -1 fix in showdesktop/main.qml is good on its own, but the margin approach needs a proper layout-level or theme-wide design.
changes: Do not invent a private opt-in '<prefix>-hint-around-applet' SVG element in plasma-desktop; any new Plasma theme SVG hint contract needs libplasma/VDG design and documentation, and ideally existing 9-piece tabbar themes should work without requiring every theme author to patch their SVG.

Do not grow the active-tab FrameSvgItem past containerMargins with negative anchors without reserving space, as this overlaps neighboring applets (visible on the vertical panel clock over the tray arrow in after-3.png and Show Desktop over the clock text in after-1.png) and clips at panel edges.

Address the System Tray tabbar highlight (plasma-workspace) and vertical-panel horizontal clipping (visible on the clock text in after-3.png) consistently with CompactApplet and Show Desktop; the z: -1 stacking fix in applets/showdesktop/main.qml can be split into its own standalone fix.
